camel_example: aliyun dds DescribeParameterTemplates --region cn-hangzhou --Role normal --EngineVersion '5.0' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Engine mongodb
description_en: Queries the default parameter templates for MongoDB instances
description_zh: 查询MongoDB实例默认的参数模板列表
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-parameter-templates --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine mongodb --engine-version 5.0 --role normal --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeParameterTemplates

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The database engine. Set the value to **mongodb**
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The role of the instance. Valid values:

- db: the shard role of a sharded cluster instance.

- cs: the config server role of a sharded cluster instance.

- mongos: the mongos role of a sharded cluster instance.

- normal: the role of a replica set instance.

- physical: the role of a single node instance.

The default value is normal
parameters.help_zh:
实例的角色类型，取值说明：

- db：分片集群shard角色。
- cs：分片集群config server角色。
- mongos：分片集群mongos角色。
- normal: 副本集角色。
- physical：单节点角色。

默认值为normal
parameters.name: role
